name: dogfood-storybook-design-system
description: Dogfood app (v1.16-2) — a React design-system Storybook 8 harness that registers 12 components (Button / Input / Card / Modal / Dropdown / Tabs / Toast / Table / Tooltip / Badge / Avatar / Icon) as StoryObj (CSF3) + play function + a11y parameters, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (spawns @storybook/react preview with a real story loader via env-skip when STORYBOOK_URL is not set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa/component createStoryRegistry + play + a11y). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/component -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
